slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: How many trained pilots does each fighter jet allocated to training produce in a given year, and is that rate constant across years or does it differ between year 1 and year 2?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked for the per-year pilot training capacity of each training jet, fully covering the slot's key meaning.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or about the pilot-to-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked when the training program starts or how many years it lasts; all questions concerned jet allocation/reallocation, not training duration.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation ended without any READY_TO_MODEL or equivalent final modeling/final answer state; the agent simply kept re-asking the same unresolved reallocation question until the transcript ended, leaving P1 slot H3 unresolved.

summary: The agent recovered the pivotal training-capacity slot (H1) and clarified the objective and production numbers, but never asked about training start/duration (H3) and did not address the pilot-to-combat-jet mapping (H2). It then looped the same unresolved reallocation question for the remainder of the interview without ever reaching a modeling state, so it neither stopped appropriately nor over-questioned productively.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
